analysis_status: post-Q4 exploratory capacity ablation; selected after observing Q4 failure of MI8; not confirmatory
research_question: Does source-only MI feature-retention count account for poor four-class FBCSP_MI8 performance?

evaluation.split: Reuse exact Q4-E001 nine source-only LOSO folds and per-fold source-fitted CSP features
evaluation.selection: MI scores fit only on eight source subjects in each outer fold; no target-based k choice
evaluation.aggregation: subject-equal mean and sample SD; exploratory descriptive only

limitation: This grid was designed after inspecting Q4-E001 results. A winner from this grid is not independently confirmed. Inner-source subject validation and external dataset remain future work.
